name: Dead Hang
description: Hang from a fixed overhead bar with straight arms to practice grip and overhead support.

items.content: Use a secure bar and wrap the thumbs around it with hands about shoulder-width apart.
Keep arms straight and allow the shoulder blades to rise naturally in a comfortable overhead position.
Keep the body quiet and breathe; avoid swinging or forcing a shoulder stretch.
Keep feet on a support to reduce the load if needed, and step down with control.

stages.name: Hang
stages.description: Hanging vertically from a fixed overhead bar with straight arms, overhand grip and feet off the floor. Head sits between the upper arms and legs hang together.
